scenario.title: 逛服飾店、試穿、比價
scenario.context: 在國外逛街或帶外國朋友逛五分埔，最常用到的是：問尺寸、要試穿、問有沒有別的顏色、評論價格。講「很多、一點點、幾件」的時候，much / many / a few / a little 會一直出現。

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.en: Hi, let me know if you need any help.
lines.zh: 嗨，需要幫忙的話跟我說。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Thanks, I'm just looking for now.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Actually, do you have this jacket in a medium?
lines.zh: 其實，這件外套有 M 號嗎？

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.en: Let me check. We only have a few left. … Here's a medium in black.
lines.zh: 我看一下，剩沒幾件了。……這件是黑色 M 號。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Do you have it in any other colors?

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.en: Not in a medium, sorry. We don't have many sizes left in this style.
lines.zh: M 號沒有了，抱歉。這款剩的尺寸不多。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: That's OK. Can I try it on?

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.en: Of course. The fitting rooms are just over there.

dialogues.title: Talking about prices with a friend

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: How much was it?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It was on sale, only eight hundred.

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Eight hundred for a leather jacket? That's a steal.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I know! But look at this T-shirt. Fifteen hundred for a plain white tee.
lines.zh: 對吧！但你看這件 T 恤，一件素白 T 要一千五。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: What a rip-off. It's probably just the logo you're paying for.
lines.zh: 也太坑了吧，應該是在付 logo 的錢。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Exactly. I don't have much money left this month anyway.
lines.zh: 就是說。反正我這個月也沒剩多少錢了。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Same. Let's just go window-shopping for a bit and then get bubble tea.
lines.zh: 我也是。那我們就隨便逛逛，然後去買珍奶。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hi, I bought this yesterday, but it's a little too small. Can I exchange it?
lines.zh: 嗨，我昨天買了這件，但有點太小。可以換嗎？

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.en: Sure. Do you have the receipt?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yes, here you go.

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.en: Would you like a larger size or a refund?
lines.zh: 你要換大一號還是退款？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: A large, if you have one.

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.en: We do. Here you are.

patterns.note: 店員來招呼時的標準回答

patterns.en: Do you have this in a medium?
Do you have it in any other colors?

patterns.note: too big / too small / too long 同樣用法

patterns.en: Can I exchange it for a different size?

chinglish.why: 試穿衣服要說 try on，try 單獨用是「嘗試、嚐嚐看」，在服飾店說 try it 對方大概懂，但聽起來像要吃它。

chinglish.wrong: This is very expensive, can cheaper?
chinglish.right: Is there any chance you could do a better price?
chinglish.why: can cheaper 是中文「可以便宜一點嗎」的直翻。一般店家不太議價，真的要問就用委婉的完整句。

chinglish.right: I have a lot of money.
chinglish.why: money 不可數，不能用 many。口語裡不管可數不可數，a lot of 最保險。

chinglish.right: These clothes are nice. / This shirt is nice.
chinglish.why: clothes 本身是複數，不能用 this。講單件衣服就直接講是什麼：shirt, jacket, dress。

grammar.title: much / many / a few / a little
grammar.oneLiner: many 和 a few 配可數，much 和 a little 配不可數；a lot of 兩種都能配。
whenToUse: many + 可數複數：many sizes, many people。
much + 不可數：much money, much time。在口語裡，much 主要出現在否定句和問句（I don't have much time / How much is it?），肯定句通常用 a lot of。
a few + 可數複數：少數幾個（正面、還有一些）。a few left。
a little + 不可數：一點點。a little sugar, a little too small。
a lot of / lots of：可數不可數都能用，口語肯定句的首選。
注意：few / little（沒有 a）意思是「幾乎沒有」，語氣偏負面。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「很多」「一點」不分名詞種類，「很多錢」「很多人」都是同一個詞。英文卻要先判斷名詞可不可數，再選 much 或 many。另外，課本常把 much 教成「很多」，但在肯定句說 I have much money 聽起來很生硬，母語者幾乎只說 a lot of。

examples.correct: We don't have many sizes left.
examples.incorrect: We don't have much sizes left.

examples.correct: I spent a lot of money today.
examples.note: 肯定句用 a lot of 最自然。

examples.correct: There are only a few left.

examples.note: a little 也可以修飾形容詞，意思是「有點」。

examples.correct: Few people know about this shop.
examples.note: few（沒有 a）= 很少人知道，語氣是「幾乎沒人」。

quiz.question: There aren't ___ people here on weekdays.
Hurry! There are only a ___ left in your size.
quiz.explanation: 可數的「幾個」用 a few。

quiz.question: Which sounds most natural?
options: I bought a lot of clothes.
I bought many clothes a lot.
quiz.explanation: 肯定句用 a lot of 最自然。

quiz.question: These pants are a ___ too long. Do you have a shorter pair?
quiz.explanation: a little too long = 有點太長（a bit 也可以）。

slang.meaning: 超划算、便宜到像用偷的
slang.usage: 形容價格非常好：It's a steal! / I got it for a steal.

risk.note: 跟店員說也沒問題，是正面的稱讚。

examples.en: Only 500 for these boots? That's a steal.
examples.zh: 這雙靴子才五百？超划算。

examples.en: I got this lamp for a steal at a flea market.
examples.zh: 這盞燈是在跳蚤市場撿到的便宜。

slang.usage: 抱怨東西不值那個價。動詞是 rip someone off（坑某人）。

risk.note: 私下跟朋友講沒問題，當著店員的面說就很不禮貌。

examples.en: 300 for a bottle of water at the airport? What a rip-off.
examples.zh: 機場一瓶水三百？也太坑。

examples.en: I think the taxi driver ripped us off.
examples.zh: 我覺得那個計程車司機坑了我們。

slang.usage: go window-shopping，逛街但沒有打算真的買。

examples.en: I'm broke, so I'm just window-shopping today.
examples.zh: 我沒錢了，今天只是看看。

examples.en: We spent the afternoon window-shopping in Ximending.
examples.zh: 我們下午在西門町隨便逛逛。

slang.usage: 形容瘋狂購物，常用在旅遊或週年慶。

risk.note: 有點老派的廣告詞感，但大家都懂，帶點幽默。

examples.en: We went to the outlet and shopped till we dropped.
examples.zh: 我們去 outlet 買到腿軟。

examples.en: Anniversary sale this weekend. Time to shop till you drop!
examples.zh: 這週末週年慶，準備買到手軟！

review.question: Could we get ___ napkins, please?
review.explanation: 複習第 5 單元：請求東西用 some。

review.question: Their beef noodle soup is to ___ for.
review.explanation: 複習第 5 單元：to die for = 好吃到不行。

review.question: We ___ (meet) some really nice people at the party.
Which is the best way to order?
review.explanation: 複習第 2 單元：I'll have… please。

review.question: Staff: "Can I help you find anything?" You: "___"
review.explanation: I'm just looking, thanks. 是標準回答。
